role: connects grust-algorithms kernels to grust-procedures signatures, providers and the shared execution budget; its examples are the current participants of the algorithms benchmark

measured_by.note: Moving source. The benchmark pins a commit per experiment and records it in each run receipt; see that repository's docs/participant-lineage.md.

predecessors.note: The benchmark's historical Grust-API columns, grustcat and grustcat-cypher, are not derived from this crate. They live in querygraph/icecat, adapt the Icecat Rust kernels to the Grust API, and target Grust 62b8b0fa2b12ec84ee02b5296969efeaf0367a58.
